text:
WLB = wage life balance 

Most of the work life balance (WLB) problems will disappear if they give everyone a huge pay raise, so we can hire a cook, a maid, a gardener.

#WLB

author.name: Louisa Lee
author.headline: Global Security and Privacy Program Lead @ Meta

comments.text:
Higher pay = higher work expectations and accountability -> stress. Those can't be solved by maids and gardeners.

Actually I found doing grocery shopping, laundry and dish washing can be therapeutic as those repeating and calming actions can distract stressful minds.
